notes: Downstage 1.3: a mixing assistant in the inspector (AI tab, ⌘J) that measures every channel and a minute of the mix, reads the console and answers with a plan of moves — faders, pans, EQ, sends, routing, inserts with their presets, effect buses, clip gain, fades, trims — that you look over and apply as one undo step; ready-made requests (balance the mix, like a reference song, more pop, rougher, warm and vintage, vocal forward, master this song, clean up the edit) or your own words; it runs on Claude, GPT, Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible service or local server, with your own API key. New sessions start with no channels, and built-in templates bring 8, 16, 24, 32 or 48 tracks; every track can be deleted; an input monitor switch (I) sits next to R on every track in the Edit window.
